title: Checkout status (checkouts.status)
caption: src/checkout/checkout.service.ts, checkout-expiry.processor.ts (checkouts.expire every minute), the booking orchestrator and account deletion. Steps on a non-open checkout answer 409 CHECKOUT_ALREADY_COMPLETED, 409 CHECKOUT_BEING_COMPLETED or 410 CHECKOUT_EXPIRED.

states.label: open
states.detail: Created by `POST /v1/checkouts`; travellers, contacts, extras, remarks editable (If-Match on `version`).

states.label: payment_pending
states.detail: A payment session exists; while a booking is `pending` the checkout stays locked.

states.label: expired
states.detail: Past `expires_at` (checkout_ttl_minutes); its authorisation voided via `payment.void` unless a pending booking holds it; also on tenant suspension.

states.label: abandoned
states.detail: The customer opened another checkout of the same priced offer, or deleted the account.

transitions.label: new checkout of same priced offer / account.delete
booking failed (refused, price changed, reconciliation or review: not booked); expired instead when past expires_at
